kurz: A test date says when you test. The AMW derives the deadline “test build ready” for everyone and shows with a traffic light whether the linked milestone will be done by then.
brauchst: The time of the test, and the weekday for recurring tests.

schritte.text: `amw termin neu --titel "Weekly test" --art test --am "13.11. 18:00"` – weekly with `--woechentlich`, until a day with `--bis YYYY-MM-DD`.
Add `--bogen <number>`. The traffic light then compares its forecast with the deadline.
Default: the test build is due 4 hours before the date. Change it with `--vorlauf <hours>`.

fehler: The agent reports the finished test build with `amw termin bereit <date> --text "what is new"`.
`amw termin absagen <date> --am "20.11. 18:00"` cancels only that occurrence.
danach: Dates are under Planning › Dates; the next test is also on the home page.
